issues.user_impact: 75% of listing cards show fragments that don't help users decide what to click
issues.business_impact: Thin content directly undermines AdSense value proposition and SEO ranking for 506 pages
issues.reproduction: Load any listing page, observe card descriptions
issues.observed: Cards show tagline/summary under 80 chars — often just naming the thing
issues.expected: Cards should show enough context to differentiate entries (objectives, use case, or enriched summary)
issues.evidence: Registry data: 118/157 resources have summary<80 chars. ResourceCard.astro:78-80 renders r.tagline || r.summary without enrichment.
issues.root_cause: Data contract has no minimum length enforcement; card component has no fallback enrichment
issues.why: Curated YAML authors wrote terse taglines; pipeline doesn't validate minimum useful length; card doesn't fall back to learning_objectives or first N words of description
issues.fix: Add fallback chain: tagline → summary → first sentence of description → first 2 learning_objectives. Enforce min 80 chars in pipeline validation.
issues.acceptance_criteria: All cards on /marketplace display >=80 chars of descriptive text or a structured fallback (objectives/steps count)
issues.tests: Unit test: render card with missing tagline falls back to description. E2E: no card-desc element has textContent.length < 40 on marketplace.

issues.user_impact: Incident responders must scroll past ~20 irrelevant sections to reach Symptoms on runbook detail pages
issues.business_impact: Core Operate use case is broken for its primary audience
issues.reproduction: Open any runbook detail page, try to find Symptoms section
issues.observed: Symptoms starts at ResourceDetail.astro:314, after Purpose/Problem/Solution/When to use/When not to use/Our assessment/What you need/Steps/Check yourself/Sourced from/Rating widget
issues.evidence: ResourceDetail.astro:111-496 renders 31 conditional + 1 unconditional section in flat sequence. Only type gate is architecture canvas at line 93.
issues.root_cause: Single template serves all 14 resource types with no type-specific section ordering
issues.why: Component was built incrementally — sections appended as new types were added without refactoring into type-aware layout
issues.fix: Define section-order arrays per type (runbook/skill/tutorial/architecture/starter/reference). Render via loop instead of 31 hardcoded conditionals.
issues.acceptance_criteria: On runbook pages, Symptoms appears within first 3 visible sections. On skill pages, install/prerequisites appear before generic sections.
issues.tests: E2E: for each type, verify first 3 rendered h2 headings match expected order

issues.user_impact: Same data rendered twice with contradictory UI (code blocks vs inline list)
issues.reproduction: Open detail page for resource with commands field
issues.observed: res.commands rendered at line 332 as code blocks AND at line 491 as inline icode list
issues.evidence: ResourceDetail.astro:332-342 and :491-496 both gated by identical condition res.commands && res.commands.length
issues.why: Second Commands block added later without noticing the first
issues.fix: Delete lines 491-496. Keep 332-342 (code-block version with copy buttons).
issues.acceptance_criteria: Only one Commands section renders per detail page
issues.tests: Grep test: res.commands appears exactly once in template body

issues.user_impact: Rating stars do nothing on static builds; Install button fails silently
issues.business_impact: Users think platform is broken; engagement features non-functional
issues.reproduction: Build static, open detail page, click stars or Install
issues.observed: Widget renders unconditionally. Client JS fetches /api/marketplace/stats which 404s in static mode. .catch(() => {}) swallows error silently.
issues.expected: Widget either hidden in static builds or shows 'unavailable' message
issues.evidence: ResourceDetail.astro:236-285 (rating), :773-815 (install). astro.config.mjs:34 output:static when !VERCEL. rate.ts prerender=false.
issues.root_cause: No build-mode guard on SSR-dependent widgets
issues.why: Component doesn't know whether it's running in static or SSR mode
issues.fix: Wrap rating+install sections in build-mode check. Replace silent catch with user-visible feedback.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Static builds show no interactive rating/install widgets, or show clear 'requires server' message
issues.tests: Build static, verify no fetch calls to /api/marketplace/* in browser network tab

issues.user_impact: Filter wall dominates viewport; 4 of 9 groups expose implementation metadata not user intent
issues.business_impact: Marketplace bounce rate; users can't find what they need
issues.reproduction: Load /marketplace on desktop, observe left column
issues.observed: 9 filter groups, 35+ checkboxes. Type group alone has 14 values including rule_pack, governance_pack. Quality Score shows internal labels (exemplary/adequate). Stage is ambiguous.
issues.expected: Primary filters (Category, Difficulty, Agent, Technology) prominent. Secondary (Verification, Security) collapsed. Implementation metadata (Type internals, Quality labels, Stage) removed or grouped.
issues.evidence: marketplace.astro:9-93 defines all filters as flat array. FilterPanel.astro:44 renders all as details elements. 4/9 groups classified as implementation metadata.
issues.root_cause: Filters derived directly from registry schema fields without UX grouping layer
issues.why: Developer convenience — every registry field became a filter without considering user mental model
issues.fix: Split into primary (4) and secondary (collapsed) filter tiers. Group 14 types into 4-5 super-categories. Remove Quality Score as filter (keep as sort).
issues.acceptance_criteria: <=5 primary filter groups visible on load. Advanced filters behind single toggle. Type filter shows <=6 grouped options.
issues.tests: E2E: count visible filter groups on initial load <= 5. Verify URL sync still works after restructure.

issues.user_impact: /projects highlights Roadmap in nav; homepage verbs don't match nav labels
issues.reproduction: Click Build on homepage, land on /projects, observe top nav active state
issues.observed: NAV_SECTION_MAP maps /projects to /roadmap. Top nav uses Roadmap/Marketplace/Categories/Tutorials/Runbooks/Docs. Homepage uses Learn/Build/Install/Operate. Three different models.
issues.expected: One consistent IA model across homepage, nav, and sidebar
issues.root_cause: Three IA models built independently at different times
issues.why: Homepage verbs, nav destinations, and sidebar groups were designed separately without reconciliation
issues.fix: Choose verb-based model as primary. Map top nav to Learn/Explore/Build/Operate + Docs. Derive sidebar from same model programmatically.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Active nav highlight matches current page for all routes. Homepage CTAs use same labels as nav.
issues.tests: E2E: visit each top-nav route, verify aria-current=page matches expected label

issues.user_impact: Two scoring systems produce divergent numbers for same resource
issues.business_impact: Trust erosion if users notice score discrepancies
issues.reproduction: Compare r.scores.completeness vs r.marketplace dimensions for same resource
issues.observed: score.mjs checks 16 canonical fields. marketplace-score.mjs checks 16 + type-specific fields. Same resource gets two different completeness numbers. Trust from System A ignored by System B.
issues.why: marketplace-score.mjs added later for richer dimensions without retiring score.mjs
issues.fix: Merge pipelines. Make marketplace-score consume score.mjs outputs as inputs, or retire score.mjs entirely.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Each resource carries exactly one set of scores. No divergence between displayed numbers.
issues.tests: Unit: for every resource, scores.completeness === marketplace-derived completeness

issues.user_impact: Unverified resources earn high composite scores because missing dimensions inflate remaining weights
issues.business_impact: Score inflation undermines entire trust model
issues.reproduction: Find resource with null performance/test_coverage/community scores, check composite
issues.observed: Null dimensions excluded from weighted average denominator. 3 null dimensions means remaining 4 get weights scaled up to sum=1.0.
issues.expected: Missing evidence penalizes or holds score at baseline
issues.root_cause: Weight redistribution treats absence as neutral rather than negative
issues.why: Design choice to not penalize incomplete data inadvertently rewards it
issues.fix: Treat null as 0 in weighted sum, or require minimum dimension coverage before assigning labels above 'unproven'. Apply evidence gap multiplier.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Resource with 4/7 null dimensions scores lower than one with 7/7 populated dimensions at same values

issues.user_impact: [object Object] rendered on detail pages for symptoms/diagnosis/skills/hooks
issues.reproduction: Open detail page where symptoms/diagnosis entries are objects
issues.observed: Object.values(s)[0] takes only first value discarding keys. Skills/Hooks/MCP render {s} directly as link text.
issues.expected: Proper key-value rendering or title extraction
issues.root_cause: Template assumes string items but data contract allows objects
issues.why: No normalization step flattens object variants to strings before rendering
issues.fix: For symptoms/diagnosis: render key as strong label + value as text. For skills/hooks/mcp: extract s.title || s.name || s.id for link text.
issues.acceptance_criteria: No [object Object] or raw JSON visible on any detail page
issues.tests: Grep rendered HTML for '[object Object]' across all detail pages = 0

issues.user_impact: orchestration stage maps to different phases depending on which file reads it
issues.business_impact: Roadmap alignment shows wrong phase for affected resources
issues.reproduction: Compare phases.ts and marketplace-score.mjs phaseMap for orchestration stage
issues.observed: phases.ts:17 maps orchestration to Trust & Operations. marketplace-score.mjs:338 maps orchestration to platforms.
issues.expected: One source of truth for stage→phase mapping
issues.root_cause: Duplicated mapping dictionary that drifted out of sync
issues.why: marketplace-score.mjs created its own phaseMap instead of importing from phases.ts
issues.fix: Delete phaseMap in marketplace-score.mjs. Import PHASES from src/lib/phases.ts.
issues.tests: Unit: phaseOf('orchestration') returns same value from both code paths

issues.user_impact: Near-duplicate categories force arbitrary classification decisions
issues.reproduction: Compare cat-streaming vs cat-kafka, cat-data-lakes vs cat-lakehouse
issues.observed: Kafka IS streaming but has separate category. Data Lakes and Lakehouse overlap. APIs Ingestion and File Ingestion split by protocol. 24/38 categories have <5 resources.
issues.expected: Categories are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive without overlap
issues.root_cause: Taxonomy grew organically without consolidation pass
issues.why: Each new concept got its own category without checking for overlap
issues.fix: Merge Kafka→Streaming, Lakes+Lakehouse→Storage, API+File Ingestion→Ingestion. Mark categories with <3 resources as 'planned'.
issues.acceptance_criteria: No overlapping category pairs. All live categories have >=3 resources or marked planned.
issues.tests: Unit: no two categories share >50% of keywords. Pipeline: warn on category with <3 resources.

issues.user_impact: Tutorial page promises objectives but cards never show them
issues.reproduction: Visit /tutorials, look for learning objectives on cards
issues.observed: Page lede says 'explicit learning objectives'. Cards use ResourceCard which shows tagline/summary only. learning_objectives never rendered on cards or detail pages.
issues.evidence: tutorials.astro:18 filters by learning_objectives. ResourceCard.astro:78-80 shows tagline||summary only. ResourceDetail.astro has no learning_objectives section.
issues.root_cause: Generic card used for specialized content type
issues.why: ResourceCard designed for marketplace, reused everywhere without variant support
issues.fix: Create TutorialCard variant showing first 2 objectives + step count. Add learning_objectives section to ResourceDetail.astro.
issues.acceptance_criteria: /tutorials cards show learning objectives. Detail pages for tutorials include objectives section.
issues.tests: E2E: /tutorials cards contain text matching learning_objectives from registry

issues.user_impact: Up to 10 badges/chips per card makes scanning impossible
issues.reproduction: Count visual elements on a fully-populated card
issues.observed: Type badge + score gauge SVG + difficulty chip + 3 tag chips + star rating chip + install count chip + verification chip + copy button = 10 elements
issues.expected: <=5 visual elements per card with clear hierarchy
issues.root_cause: Every available metadata field rendered without prioritization
issues.why: Additive development — each new field got appended without removing less important ones
issues.fix: Restructure card: Row 1 = type badge + score. Row 2 = title. Row 3 = tagline (max 2 lines). Row 4 = install button. Row 5 = difficulty + 2 tags + verification. Move ratings/installs to bottom or hide on compact view.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Max 6 visual elements per card. Install action above fold within card.

issues.user_impact: prerequisites vs what_you_need mismatch silently penalizes tutorial completeness scores
issues.reproduction: Check completeness score for tutorial using what_you_need instead of prerequisites
issues.observed: CANONICAL_FIELDS includes prerequisites but not what_you_need. Tutorial YAML uses what_you_need. Normalizer defaults prerequisites to [].
issues.expected: Equivalent fields treated identically by scoring
issues.root_cause: Canonical field list doesn't account for tutorial-specific naming convention
issues.why: Schema evolved with different field names for similar concepts across types
issues.fix: Add what_you_need to CANONICAL_FIELDS or treat as alias for prerequisites during normalization.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Tutorial using what_you_need gets same completeness credit as one using prerequisites

issues.user_impact: Empty state gives no guidance on how to recover
issues.observed: Single sentence 'No resources match the current filters.' No clear-all CTA, no suggestions, no partial matches.
issues.expected: Actionable empty state with recovery options
issues.root_cause: Empty state is static string, not interactive component
issues.why: Minimal implementation that was never iterated on
issues.fix: Add 'Clear all filters' button. Suggest removing last-applied filter. Show closest matches.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Empty state includes at least one actionable recovery button
issues.tests: E2E: apply impossible filter combo, verify clear-all button visible and functional
